gaps.explanation: p6 Statement of Revenues, Expenses, and Changes in Fund Net Position - Proprietary Funds prints four enterprise columns (Electric, Water, Sewer, Gas) with no schedule of their own; detail[] has no business-type lines. JSON receipts = total operating revenues 89,735,475 + investment income 3,070,305 + grant revenue 4,200 + insurance recoveries 1,928,214 = 94,738,194 (gain (loss) on sale of assets is in business_type.other_financing, see below). Per column: Electric 56,979,873 + 246,326 + 1,830,234 + 1,063,135 = 60,119,568; Water 5,465,938 + 54,987 + 269,715 + 58,214 = 5,848,854; Sewer 9,085,855 + 668,089 + 634,751 + 4,200 + 761,106 = 11,154,001; Gas 17,234,407 + 335,605 + 45,759 = 17,615,771. Sum 94,738,194 = statement. Internal Service Funds column excluded. (Governmental revenue/expenditure gaps: different basis, explained in pass 1.)
